info.name:
Dismisses a slice of open time by creating a soft-deleted user activity
that fills the gap. Open time is derived from the gaps between activities,
so filling the gap is what removes it. Emits no events.

info.name: ActivityController_copyActivities_v1

Allows a requester with TimeServicePermission.CustomerAnyUserAnyActivityRead (ie. Super Laurel Admin)
to view activities from other Customer Users. This is used in the admin dashboard context.
